formula: X accounted for / made up / constituted the largest share
note: Найчастіша фраза для найбільшого сектора кругової діаграми.
example: Housing costs accounted for the largest share of the budget, at 38%.

exercises.practice: Transport was the biggest part of spending in the second chart, taking up 45%.
exercises.answer: Transport accounted for the largest share of spending in the second chart, at 45%.
exercises.answerNote: "was the biggest part of, taking up" → одне дієслово accounted for.

exercises.practice: Salaries were the biggest part of the company's costs, taking up 55% of the total.
exercises.answer: Salaries accounted for the largest share of the company's costs, at 55% of the total.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама формула — "accounted for" підходить майже до будь-якого pie chart.

exercises.practice: In the second chart, rent was the biggest expense, making up 40%.
exercises.answer: In the second chart, rent constituted the largest share of expenses, at 40%.

formula: X represented more than half of the total, dwarfing Y
note: Коли один сектор — це більшість кола, а інший — крихітний.
example: Renewable sources represented more than half of the total energy mix, dwarfing coal's 4% share.

exercises.practice: More than half of visitors came from Europe, and only a tiny number came from Africa, just 3%.
exercises.answer: European visitors represented more than half of the total, dwarfing the mere 3% from Africa.
exercises.answerNote: Об'єднали два окремих факти в одне речення через dwarfing.

exercises.practice: More than half of the app's users were under 25, and hardly any were over 60, just 2%.
exercises.answer: Users under 25 represented more than half of the app's total user base, dwarfing the mere 2% aged over 60.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама структура: більше число — головне речення, менше — після "dwarfing".

exercises.practice: Beef made up over half of meat consumption, and lamb was almost nothing, only 3%.
exercises.answer: Beef represented more than half of total meat consumption, dwarfing the negligible 3% share of lamb.
exercises.answerNote: "the negligible 3% share of" — трохи довший варіант "the mere 3%".

formula: The share of X was [number] times that of Y
note: Для точної кратності між двома секторами діаграми.
example: The share of income spent on food was three times that of income spent on entertainment.

exercises.practice: The percentage of the budget for staff was much bigger than the percentage for equipment, 60% against 15%.
exercises.answer: The share of the budget spent on staff was four times that of equipment, at 60% against 15%.
exercises.answerNote: 60 ÷ 15 = 4 — порахували точну кратність замість розмитого "much bigger".

exercises.practice: The share of the market held by Brand A was much bigger than Brand C's share, 48% against 12%.
exercises.answer: The share of the market held by Brand A was four times that of Brand C, at 48% against 12%.

exercises.practice: The percentage of trips made by car was much higher than trips made by bike, 66% versus 11%.
exercises.answer: The share of trips made by car was six times that of trips made by bike, at 66% versus 11%.
exercises.answerNote: 66 ÷ 11 = 6 — завжди рахуй точну кратність перед тим, як писати речення.

formula: X and Y together made up the vast majority of the total
note: Коли два сектори разом займають більшу частину кола.
example: Coal and gas together made up the vast majority of electricity generation, at 71%.

exercises.practice: Cars and buses together were most of the transport used, making up 82% between them.
exercises.answer: Cars and buses together made up the vast majority of transport used, at 82%.
exercises.answerNote: "were most of... making up" → формальне made up the vast majority of.

exercises.practice: Fiction and non-fiction sales were most of total book sales, together making up 88%.
exercises.answer: Fiction and non-fiction sales together made up the vast majority of total book sales, at 88%.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама формула — просто переставили "together" перед дієсловом.

exercises.practice: China and India were most of the world's rice production shown in the chart, 78% combined.
exercises.answer: China and India together made up the vast majority of the world's rice production shown, at 78%.

formula: Only a negligible slice belonged to Y
note: Для найменшого, майже непомітного сектора діаграми.
example: Only a negligible slice of the pie, just 1%, belonged to nuclear power.

exercises.practice: Just 2% of the total belonged to "other sources" in the chart.
exercises.answer: Only a negligible slice of the total, just 2%, belonged to "other sources".
exercises.answerNote: Додали формальне only a negligible slice замість голого "just 2%".

exercises.practice: Just 1.5% of the pie chart belonged to "unknown causes".
exercises.answer: Only a negligible slice of the chart, just 1.5%, belonged to "unknown causes".
exercises.answerNote: Та сама структура — заміни лише категорію.

exercises.practice: Hardly any of the budget, only 0.8%, went to marketing.
exercises.answer: Only a negligible slice of the budget, just 0.8%, went to marketing.
exercises.answerNote: "hardly any... only" → "only a negligible slice... just".
